The city council's transport department has denied claims, circulating in anonymous Telegram channels, that fares will double from 1 November. According to the head of the department, the executive committee has made no decision to change fares, and no such draft has even been submitted for consideration. The current price of a single journey on buses, trolleybuses and trams will remain unchanged at least until the end of this year. Discounted travel for pensioners, students and other groups is also fully preserved in line with current legislation. The department stressed that, under the regulations, any change in fares goes through public consultation and is published on the city council's official website at least a month before it takes effect. Night routes will run on their usual timetable, and the renewal of the tram fleet continues under the approved programme. Residents were urged to check information on official sources and not to share unverified messages. The department also said it had asked the cyber police to identify the authors of the posts.
